caption: A lit match is dropped into a fire pit filled with kindling, and the fire catches and grows from the bottom up.

sa.check: A fire pit is filled with kindling.
A lit match is dropped into it.
The kindling catches where the match lands.
The flames spread upward through the kindling.
The fire grows from the bottom up rather than starting at the top.

pc.expect: The kindling catches at the spot the match lands and the fire spreads from there.
pc.fail: The kindling catches before the match lands; or the match lands among the kindling and nothing catches at all; or the fire starts at the top of the pile while the match lies at the bottom; or the fire starts at a corner of the pit the match never reached.

pc.expect: The fire only spreads and the charred kindling stays charred.
pc.fail: Charred kindling turns back to pale wood; or the flame front retreats leaving unburnt kindling behind it; or the fire catches, goes out and catches again with nothing added; or the pile grows as it burns.

pc.expect: The flames climb upward through the pile and the smoke rises, while embers and ash settle down.
pc.fail: The flames travel downward from the top of the pile; or the smoke sinks and pools around the pit; or the flames hang below the pit's floor; or ash rises and stays aloft.

pc.expect: The kindling sticks char, curl and crumble and the pile settles as they burn, while the pit stays a rigid ring.
pc.fail: A stick melts and drips; or the sticks stay pale and straight while flames cover them; or the pile lifts as one solid block; or the pit's stones sag.

pc.expect: The kindling in the pit is the kindling that burns and the match is one stick; nothing appears from nowhere.
pc.fail: New kindling appears in the pit; or a stick vanishes leaving no ash; or a second lit match appears; or the match passes through the pit's floor.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pit's stones, the ground and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The stones rearrange; or the ground changes texture; or the background changes between frames.

note: Who drops the match is not judged.
